calls.title: [Save the date] GrowthBook | Adoption Plan
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team solidified a September 17 target for full platform setup to align with an upcoming McDonald’s town meeting, highlighting the urgency due to August vacation schedules. Technical requirements, including single sign-on (SSO) and data warehouse connectivity, were emphasized as critical. Next steps were outlined, with technical sessions scheduled for the following week to facilitate setup. The option to retain the existing Wells testing environment was favored for speed, pending a review of its configurations. Data privacy compliance under GDPR was addressed, with a dedicated customer success manager appointed for support. Internal readiness and teamwork were deemed essential to ensure the success of the implementation, with the setup expected to take 1-2 days.
calls.keywords: Single Sign-On, Data Warehouse Integration, Customer Success Manager, Environment Migration, Data Privacy Compliance, Adoption Timeline
